subject: Interview today — candidate stuck in immigration line, switch onsite to phone?
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@hirely.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrea Park <andrea.park@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 12:08:00 -0400
Subject: Confirm — Andrea Park onsite 2pm (Room B)

Hi team,

Quick confirmation that Andrea Park will be onsite today at 2:00 PM in Room B for the Senior Infra Engineer loop (coding + system design). Andrea sent over an updated resume a few minutes ago (attached).

Agenda:
- 2:00–2:30 PM: Coding with Markus
- 2:35–3:05 PM: System design with Grace

Andrea is traveling from JFK and said customs usually moves fast — flagged for arrival ~1:30 PM. I'll stay on standby in case anything shifts.

Attachments:
- Andrea_Park_Resume.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Senior Recruiter, Hirely
samira@hirely.com

---

From: Andrea Park <andrea.park@gmail.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@hirely.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 13:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Confirm — Andrea Park onsite 2pm (Room B)

Hi Samira / Marissa —

Really sorry for the last-minute note. I'm currently stuck in a very long immigration line at the port of entry. Officers just announced a temporary hold for additional screening due to staffing. It looks like this could take at least 60–90 mins.

I know the panel is tight — happy to do a phone interview from the arrivals area if that helps salvage the loop. My phone is +1 (646) 555-0183. If not, I'm available to convert the system-design slot to a 30-min phone call at 3:15 PM EST or do a recorded take-home instead. Apologies for the disruption.

— Andrea

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@hirely.com>, Andrea Park <andrea.park@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Confirm — Andrea Park onsite 2pm (Room B)

Thanks for the heads up Andrea — really appreciate the options. Grace/Markus, are you able to pivot to a phone loop?

Options I propose (ranked):
1) Swap onsite -> phone for both sessions and run the loop immediately (Markus start at 2:05 PM phone). Andrea can call from arrivals — we will treat it as the live interview.
2) If logistics don't work, compress coding to 20 min and convert system design to a 30-min phone at 3:15 PM EST.
3) If neither, cancel onsite and request a recorded design doc + follow-up short phone (we'd still like to get screening done today).

Markus — can you start on phone at 2:05 if Andrea calls? Grace — if Markus does coding, can you keep 2:35–3:05 open for a phone call? If you prefer not to, we can move the loop to tomorrow AM (we have a small bench of interviewers but would prefer same-day).

Samira — please text Andrea's number to the front desk in case she rounds the building (646-555-0183). Also upload the attached resume to the panel doc (I attached interview-guide.pdf with question focus).

I'll be nearby and can triage the front desk / room booking if the candidate arrives.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Hiring Lead, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@hirely.com>, Andrea Park <andrea.park@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Confirm — Andrea Park onsite 2pm (Room B)

Marissa / Grace — quick update and brief debrief from the shifted loop.

We moved to Option 1: Markus (me) started at ~2:10 PM on phone — Andrea dialed in from arrivals and had intermittent background noise but overall solid. I did a 20-min coding exercise (shared Google Doc) and covered core problem-solving. Grace joined at 2:40 PM for a 25-min system-design phone call. We pushed a bit on tradeoffs and infra scaling. Overall: candidate shows strong design sense but had a couple of optimization gaps in the coding portion.

Recommended next step: invite to a paired-coding takehome (3-hour) to validate implementation details before scheduling an on-site return. If we want to push forward without takehome, we'd need at least one more onsite coding session with a whiteboard.

Attachments: interview-guide.pdf (panel notes we used)

Also: Andrea was professional and communicative — the immigration hold was outside of her control and she handled it well. I think same-day pivot to phone kept the process moving and was appreciated.

Markus
Staff Engineer
Redwood Inference
